skill_name: Develop a prediction model to predict the stock price of company X.
workflow: Developing a prediction model to predict stock prices of company X requires thorough data analysis and understanding of the company's market action. First, collect data related to related market indices and put them in a time-series dataset. Then use a regression model such as a linear regression or an Artificial Neural Network to create a prediction model. Exploratory data analysis should be conducted to identify factors affecting the stock prices, such as company news, macroeconomic conditions
